searched.title: TDS of Bambu PETG Matte V1.0
searched.note: All 3 pages read (text layer page by page, each checked against the rendered page): Recommended Printing Settings (p.1), Physical and Thermal Properties with the moisture-absorption and deformation charts (p.2), Mechanical Properties with specimen drawings and the test note, Other Physical and Chemical Properties (p.3). searched.title: Bambu PETG Matte Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701G03 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)
searched.note: All 18 pages read (text layer). The manufacturer's own SDS for "Bambu PETG Matte", model "G03-xx(xx stands for any suffix)". Section 3: PETG 70-80 % and additive 20-30 % by wt; section 9 "No data available" for every property but physical state "Thread"; CLP "Not classified"; not hazardous goods for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI transport. No spec value is stored from it.

documents.title: TDS of Bambu PETG Matte V1.0
Bambu PETG Matte Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701G03 (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd.)
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PETG Matte
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 30.1 ± 1 MPa, elongation 6.5 ± 0.5 %, bending modulus 1750 ± 46 MPa, bending strength 47 ± 2.3 MPa, impact 10.0 ± 1.5 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density (ISO 1183) and the DSC melting and glass transition temperatures are raw-material properties and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows; the registry has no *.printed / *.material key pair, so the split is by key group and test_condition. The Vicat and HDT rows do not state their specimen form.

The TDS V1.0 has no Specifications section: material.diameter (1.75 mm), material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) and material.net_weight (1kg) stay the store page's own rows (Product Features › bullet 6; option Size › 1kg). They are not restated here and not marked not_published.
not_published: filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched (TDS, SDS, the three wiki pages, the store page).

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 3349 ± 130 MPa, Z 3174 ± 50 MPa), melt index (13.9 ± 1.5 g/10 min at 235 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), saturated water absorption rate (0.29% at 25 °C, 55% RH) and its moisture-absorption chart (25~30°C, 55~70% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed, with desiccant), retraction length (0.4 - 0.8 mm) and speed (30 - 60 mm/s), max overhang angle (~ 70 °), max bridging length (~ 30 mm), suggested annealing (60 to 70 °C, 6 to 12 hours), colour and state, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. Not stored although a registry key exists: heat deflection temperature 72.3 °C at 0.45 MPa (thermal.heat_deflection_temp keeps the 1.8 MPa row, as in every other filament file) and the chamber temperature (35 - 50 °C; see the chamber note). Printer and AMS compatibility, build plates, nozzle sizes, support material and glue are kept as relations; the nozzle sizes are also extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters.

The TDS p.1 footnote ("*Maximum exposure time for filaments in ambient air before noticeable degradation in print quality occurs ...") has no starred row on the page; no exposure-time value is published in the TDS. The store page gives 72 hours above 50% RH as the point at which to dry (feature block footnote and FAQ 2); no registry key holds it.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (35 - 50 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability, not a filament print setting.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: identified use "3D printing filament", composition (PETG 70-80 %, additive 20-30 % by wt), CLP "Not classified", no PBT/vPvB substance or endocrine disruptor, "Not hazardous goods" for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO-TI transport, SVHC and the other REACH lists "Not listed". Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values. Its section 5 says "No data available" for combustion products, while the TDS says "Water, carbon oxides". The SDS model "G03-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : G03-xx(xx stands for any suffix)") is not written to identity.model: identity rows come from the reviewed identity map (§C.1; the builder writes "PETG Matte"), and a curated official_doc row would outrank it with a designation carrying a wildcard suffix.

No wiki page names PETG Matte, and the store FAQ says it "uses a specially modified formula", so the generic PETG wiki rows (material-table nozzle 240 - 270 °C ± 10 °C, bed 60 - 80 °C, oven drying 70 ℃ for 8 h, AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT 65 ℃ for 12 h; PETG wiki and drying wiki 60 - 65 °C for 8 h in an oven, 80 °C or 75-85 °C for 12 h on a heatbed) are not applied and not recorded as conflicts. The TDS values are kept.

Consistency with the parsed store page: the store page states none of the values this file holds as numbers (its diameter, tolerance and net weight rows are not restated), so there is nothing to disagree with. Its density and nozzle-temperature rows are not_found and are replaced by the TDS values.

Marketing prose proves no number and is not stored: "Prints like PLA. Lasts like PETG.", "handles moisture better than most PETG filaments", "Tough enough to earn the name", "high strength and toughness, excellent layer adhesion" (store page and TDS p.1).

The store FAQ (4. Important Notice) says "PETG Matte is not recommended as a support for PLA" and points to Bambu PETG Basic for multi-material support. "Not recommended" is neither compatible nor incompatible, so no not_compatible_with relation is written; the note sits on the Support for PLA/PETG relation.

material.spool_type is neither stored nor marked not_published: no source names the spool (the TDS has no spool row, the store page only offers Type "Filament with spool" / "Refill"), and the Type option group carries the choice (same treatment as pla-pure and the other PETG files).

Hex: all 8 store colours have exactly one hex tile, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses; values read from the text layer and identical to the sampled colour of each rendered tile.
The store FAQ (5.Safety Tips) says the filament is not food-grade; no registry key holds this.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the gallery has an "In_the_Box_3.jpg" image but the page has no What's in the Box section or list).

The store page links documents that were not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/0f611d04e95043a1ba4fbcb6db22a287/2601Q46345A_G03-xx_Rohs.pdf) and the wiki guide https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/general/swaping-new-filament-with-bambu-reusable-spool. safety.certifications therefore stays unverified.

The TDS is served from store.bblcdn.eu, the host the store page itself links (Download › "Filament TDS"). That host is not in the package DOCUMENT_HOSTS, so the builder drops the page's TDS link and mergeCurated's documentRow drops this file's TDS document entry; the TDS values themselves merge (their provenance is source_title, locator and quote). To review: add store.bblcdn.eu to the document hosts, or keep the TDS link off the Documents tab.

Adjudication against the second extraction (55 field disagreements): locator wording (17 spec locators and the "All Bambu 3D printers" relation: "p.N, Section › Row" kept over "p.N › Section › Row"; the 8 hex cells; the refill relation's "Printing Tips (FAQ, components[4])") keeps this file's form, the form of every other filament file. thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (71.2 °C), as in every other filament file; the 0.45 MPa row (72.3 °C) the second extraction took is noted. compat.statement stays the TDS Printers Compatibility cell; the AMS Compatibility row stays one ams_series family relation with the TDS's own label rather than four per-unit relations (the builder already writes the four store-page "All AMS Series" relations). safety.certifications stays unverified (§C.6: a store-page feature-bullet claim; the RoHS PDF was not read). Build plates, support and glue stay compatible_with (not recommended_with), as in petg-basic, pla-pure and pla-tough-upgrade. extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters is added from the TDS Nozzle Size row; the nozzle relation stays. Not added from the second extraction: thermal.chamber_temp (see the chamber note), identity.model (see the SDS note) and material.spool_type "Refill" / "Filament with spool" (option names, not a spool type; see the spool note). The TDS p.3 note names the test printer "Tuozhu H2D" on the rendered page (the text layer drops the "D"), so the mechanical test_condition keeps H2D.
